| Category = Cookie recipes
| Difficulty = 2
}}

{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Dessert]]

== Ingredients ==
* ¾ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], [[Cookbook:Applesauce|applesauce]], equal parts butter and [[Cookbook:Vegetable oil|vegetable oil]], or [[Cookbook:Shortening|shortening]]
* 1 ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]], firmly packed
* 1 [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]]
* ⅓ cup [[Cookbook:Water|water]] or [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
* 1 ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]]
* 3 cup raw [[Cookbook:Oats|oats]] (rolled or quick/old fashioned)
* 1 cup all-purpose [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
* ½ tsp [[Cookbook:Baking Soda|baking soda]]
* ½ tsp [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* ¼ tsp [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]]
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Raisin|raisins]]
* ¾ cup [[Cookbook:Walnut|walnuts]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]

== Procedure ==
# Heat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 350°F.
# Lightly grease [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|cookie sheet]] with oil, shortening, or butter.
# Combine your choice of fat (butter, apple sauce, butter/vegetable oil mix, or shortening), brown sugar, egg, milk, and vanilla; beat with mixer on high speed to blend well.
# Combine oats, flour, baking soda, salt and cinnamon; add to shortening mixture and combine until just blended.
# Stir in raisins and nuts.
# Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet, 2 inches apart.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for 10–13 minutes, or until lightly browned.
